name: Ugarit Solar Eclipse
note: Recorded on a clay tablet from Ugarit; one of the earliest dated eclipse reports.

name: Eclipse of Thales
note: Said to have halted a battle between Lydians and Medes (Herodotus).

name: Arbela Lunar Eclipse
note: Observed before Alexander's battle at Gaugamela.

name: Jerusalem Lunar Eclipse
note: Often discussed in chronologies of the first century CE.

name: King Henry's Eclipse
note: Total solar eclipse over England; associated with the death of Henry I in chronicles.

name: Spanish Solar Eclipse
note: Widely recorded across Iberia and southern Europe.

name: Coimbra Solar Eclipse
note: Observed in Portugal; early modern European records.

name: Halley's Eclipse
note: Edmond Halley predicted the path across England.

name: Tecumseh's Eclipse
note: Predicted by Tenskwatawa; visible across the eastern United States.

name: King of Siam Eclipse
note: Predicted by King Mongkut; observed in present-day Thailand.

name: Eddington Eclipse
note: Used to test general relativity via starlight deflection.

name: New York City Eclipse
note: Totality grazed New York; widely photographed.

name: Baja California Eclipse
note: Long totality over Mexico and Hawaii.

name: European Solar Eclipse
note: Path crossed Cornwall, France, Germany, Turkey, and India.

name: Great American Eclipse
note: Coast-to-coast path across the contiguous United States.

name: North American Eclipse
note: Path from Mexico through the US Midwest to eastern Canada.

name: East Asia Eclipse
note: Projected path across China, Korea, and Japan.
